note: Weights are target shares of output (sum 100). Order of priority follows the channel owner: religious, history, sports, science, math, physics, comedy, chemistry.

religious.narrative: calm, respectful, source-first storytelling; no fatwa, no invented quotes
religious.visual_grammar: symbolic and architectural light, calligraphic geometry without depicting prophets or Imams as figures, restrained camera

history.narrative: chronological reconstruction with place, date and cause-effect
history.visual_grammar: reconstructed environments, maps with animated borders and routes, architecture, period-appropriate objects

sports.visual_grammar: pitch or track geometry, motion trails, animated statistics, kinetic camera

science.visual_grammar: literal mechanism models, scale changes, cutaways, cell and planet scale transitions

math.visual_grammar: 3D curves, surfaces, animated constructions and proofs, neon construction lines

physics.narrative: thought experiment, then law, then consequence
physics.visual_grammar: fields, waves, particles, spacetime grids, simulated phenomena

comedy.narrative: original character, setup, escalation, punchline; unique story each time
comedy.visual_grammar: stylized characters with exaggerated motion, comic timing cuts, situational props

chemistry.visual_grammar: 3D molecules with bonds, reaction animations, periodic-table spatial layouts
